title: Sab Moh Maaya Hai
desc: Ramnaresh, a poor peon nearing retirement, faces conflict with his son Piyush, who blames reservations for his joblessness. But Piyush later realizes his father's love and sacrifices.

title: Shirdi Ke Sai Baba
desc: A doctor visits Shirdi with his ailing son, torn between faith and science. To save his child, he must decide if Sai Baba's blessings hold the cure he desperately seeks.

title: Mr. India
desc: Arun shelters a group of orphans and is harassed by a gangster eyeing his house. After a child dies, he uses his father's invisibility watch to fight back.

title: Chori Chori Chupke Chupke
desc: Raj and Priya hire Madhubala as a surrogate. But when Madhubala falls for Raj and claims the child as her own, love, betrayal, and chaos turn their lives upside down.

title: Desh Premee
desc: Master Dinanath, a freedom fighter, flees his village with his son Raju and finds refuge with four crooks. Unaware of their deceit, he strives to reform and unite them.

title: Gadar 2
desc: Tara Singh goes missing during a skirmish and is believed captured in Pakistan. His son Jeete sets out to rescue him, plunging them into a deadly maze they must escape at all costs.

title: Indian
desc: Policeman Raj arrests terrorist Wasim Khan and earns praise, but when his father-in-law is mysteriously murdered, Raj is framed and must prove his innocence.

title: Khamoshi
desc: Annie, daughter of a hearing and speech-impaired couple, falls for Raj who brings music and love into her life. She faces challenges when her family rejects their relationship.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: 2.0 Robot
desc: When mobile phones mysteriously fly from people's hands, Dr Vaseegaran and Nila investigate. To stop Pakshi Rajan's chaos, they must revive Chitti for a decisive battle.

title: Mrs. Chatterjee Vs Norway
desc: Debika Chatterjee fights Norwegian authorities to regain custody of her children, battling cultural bias and legal hurdles in a foreign land.

title: Main Khiladi Tu Anari
desc: Inspector Karan seeks justice for his brother Arjun's murder. But Deepak, an actor, complicates things by shadowing him to add realism to his role.

title: Awarapan
desc: Shivam, a hitman, is ordered to watch a woman. He finds out she's trapped in a trafficking ring and decides to help her reunite with her true love.

title: Karma
desc: To avenge an insult, a terrorist kills a jailer's family. Seeking revenge, the jailer enlists three death-row inmates to help him carry out his daring plan.

title: Kesari
desc: Havildar Ishar Singh leads 21 brave Sikh soldiers against 10,000 Pashtun invaders, creating one of history's greatest last stands of courage and sacrifice.

title: RRR
desc: A fearless revolutionary reunites with a British officer he once shared a bond with. Together, they set aside differences to fight despotic rulers, forging an inspiring path to freedom.
